text: I think it's mostly about the way people communicate with the singer.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: In the past, if you listened to music, you could only listen — maybe you were surprised by a singer, maybe you liked them, but you couldn't communicate with them.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But now, with music apps, you can sometimes interact with those singers directly.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: It's like reading a book and being able to talk with the writer.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And it's also just way more convenient to listen through apps now, instead of cassettes or MP3 players.
